description.value: Circle K is a 24-hour convenience store and petrol station on Williams Road in Richmond, part of the global Couche-Tard/Circle K network. Touring cyclists will find a broad selection of packaged snacks and drinks alongside hot food options including a Roller Grill and fresh coffee. The store operates around the clock, making it a reliable stop at any hour of the day or night.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Circle K website store locator page confirms the address (9951 Williams Road, Richmond, V7A 1H3) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The services list on the website explicitly names Public Restrooms, Fresh Food Fast, Coffee, and Roller Grill, giving positive evidence for washrooms and hot food. No mention of bike racks, bike parking, or water bottle refill appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Website page header reads 'Petrol station at 9951 WILLIAMS ROAD, RICHMOND, United States' — the country is incorrectly listed as United States; the postal code V7A 1H3 and country code CA confirm this is a Canadian location in Richmond, BC. Likely a chain website template error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible 24-hour convenience store with confirmed location and services; useful to touring cyclists for food, hot drinks, and restrooms.
